title: Global functions acting on derived morphisms of module sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $E,E\prime\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Encode a global function $f$ as a compatible family of local sections, equivalently as an element of $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ by evaluation at the top open. The canonical scalar multiple $f\alpha$ of a morphism $\alpha:E\to E\prime$ is obtained by localizing the sectionwise scalar action on morphisms of module sheaves [def-pur-sheaf-modules-hom-module] to their derived category.

source.place: Tag 08EJ (Lemma 36.13.9), the expression f^n alpha and the global-function linearity in its proof
